title: Fast & Functional
description: Simple optimization and QoL pack including JEI, Resourcify, Trade Cycling, and Mouse Tweaks.
body: Fast & Functional is just a simple lightweight pack made to fix lag and add basic features Minecraft should already have. It wont change the base game or add random content you dont care about. It just makes everything run smoother.On the performance side it has a ton of optimization mods to maximize your FPS and eliminate stuttering on low end PCs.For quality of life it includes:JEI for quick recipe lookupsResourcify to download resource packs in gameTrade Cycling to refresh villager trades instantlyMouse Tweaks for fast inventory managementThats pretty much it. Clean, fast, and stays out of your way.
